title: Romantic Vietnam Odyssey
headline: Hanoi, a night on Halong Bay, then Saigon together.
description: Seven days for two: Old Quarter evenings in Hanoi, an overnight cruise among Halong’s limestone karsts, and three nights in Ho Chi Minh City.
image_alt: Limestone karsts rising from Halong Bay at dusk
price_guidance: Indicative from twin sharing, excluding international flights and visa fees. Cabin category on Halong Bay and city hotel style are confirmed in your written quote.
overview: A honeymoon-paced journey through north and south. Begin in Hanoi’s lakes and Old Quarter, sail overnight through Halong Bay, then fly south for Saigon’s energy, river evenings and a day on the Mekong if you wish. Designed for couples who want iconic Vietnam without a group timetable.
highlights: Two nights in Hanoi with time for Hoan Kiem Lake and Old Quarter walks.
Overnight Halong Bay cruise with cabin, meals and kayak time as included.
Three nights in Ho Chi Minh City for dining, museums and riverside evenings.
Private airport and hotel transfers in each city.
why: North and south in one week, without rushing every landmark.
A night on the water between two city stays.
Pace and dining can be shaped around the two of you.
inclusions: Airport and hotel transfers in a private vehicle
Overnight Halong Bay cruise with selected meals onboard
Domestic flight Hanoi–Ho Chi Minh City, once ticketed
exclusions: Optional Cu Chi or Mekong day tours unless added to your quote
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees

notes: Cruise operator, cabin type and city hotels are confirmed only after you approve the written inclusions. Bay itineraries depend on weather and maritime permissions. An inquiry is not a booking.
